promotionPolicy.notes: No record created by this pipeline may be promoted automatically.

confidencePolicy.unverified: Lead only; not safe for game-data claims.
confidencePolicy.observed: Seen in one relevant source or real character observation.
confidencePolicy.cross-checked: Supported by at least two evidence entries.
confidencePolicy.verified: High-confidence record with at least two evidence entries and explicit human review.
confidencePolicy.rejected: Known bad, incompatible, stale, or region-mismatched data.
